Jim Lail and Associates, Inc. is a premier Sales and Marketing Agency representing some of the industry’s top manufacturing brands for the Wholesale Hardware/Retail Market, Home Center, Farm and Agricultural Supply, Industrial Supply, Automotive Distribution/Retail and Plumbing and Electrical Supply Markets.

The agency footprint spreads nationwide through accounts based in VA, NC, SC, GA, FL, AL, MS, LA, TX, OK, AR, TN and Southern WV.
